title: My Chromebook is frozen
summary: The screen is stuck, or the Chromebook won't respond when you click or type.

steps.title: Check for damage first
instructions: Check for a cracked screen, liquid spills, missing keys, or a broken hinge.
steps.question: Do you see any damage?

steps.title: Close the app that is stuck
instructions: Press the Search key and the Esc key at the same time. This opens Task Manager.
Click the app or tab that says "Not responding", or the one you were using when it froze.
steps.question: Is your Chromebook working normally now?

steps.title: Turn it off and on again
instructions: Press and hold the power button until the screen goes dark. This can take up to 10 seconds.
Press the power button once to turn it back on, then sign in.
steps.question: Did it start up and work normally?

steps.title: Charge the battery
instructions: Plug the charger into the Chromebook and into a wall outlet.
Press the power button to turn it on.
steps.question: Did it turn on and work normally?

steps.title: Do a hardware reset
instructions: Turn off the Chromebook by holding the power button until the screen goes dark.
Press and hold the Refresh key (the circle arrow above the number 3 or 4).
While holding Refresh, tap the power button once.
When the Chromebook starts, let go of Refresh.
steps.warning: A hardware reset can delete files saved only in your Downloads folder. Files in Google Drive are safe. Do NOT use "Powerwash" unless a technician tells you to.
steps.question: Is your Chromebook working normally now?
